source_title: The Exit Plan Is A School
summary: This first paid-subscriber livestream turns Jiang's platform from publication surface into institutional plan: subscriber support makes exit from China possible, the future-school course becomes a school-community blueprint, and the audience is asked to trade influencer/fame logic and wealth chasing for education, local impact, consciousness, and community.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: future school means curriculum reform, school-community design, and a real school for Jiang's children rather than a channel-only project.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Living School page already has a durable anchor for the school dream surviving a single classroom; this source supplies the latest practical turn from dream to relocation, course blueprint, and site scouting.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: school can either democratize creativity and purpose or unravel the soul by blinding students to their telos.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Education page owns formation as the active mechanism. This source sharpens the positive/negative fork: education unlocks creativity when rightly designed and damages the soul when it trains people away from purpose.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as the 2026-06-13 practical institutional turn: Jiang leaves the school job, declares China hopeless for the reform project after roughly thirty years, plans a one-year search for a stable post-China base, and frames paid-subscriber meetups, Dante seminars, future-school coursework, and possible Malaysia/North America locations as steps toward school-building.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Living School owns the institutional form and site-choice problem. Education As A Soul Game owns the formative mechanism inside schooling; Attention Capture owns platform/influencer refusal only when attention extraction is the active mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Kabbalah/creativity and soul-unraveling passages for a future Education replacement pass: right education democratizes creative power, while ordinary schooling can blind people to telos and unravel the soul.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education gets the formation/damage fork. Eschatology or Kabbalah should receive this only when a future source makes the sacred system itself primary rather than the educational effect.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as routing evidence if Attention Capture later needs a platform-growth boundary: Jiang explicitly refuses the influencer/media-company path because management, profit, and brand scaling would consume the teacher and weaken the educational mission.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not append this to Attention now. The active mechanism in this source is institutional education; attention economics is a guardrail around what the platform must not become.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the stream's time-bound forecasts for later comparison rather than canon promotion: ground invasion remains expected, infrastructure targeting becomes the pain-per-dollar shift, AI/Nvidia are framed as bubble finance, Tulsi/RFK/Trump claims are near-term U.S. political forecasts, and peace with Iran is declared no longer possible.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns later auditability. War Story/Chokepoint may own the material targeting logic, and Power As Alchemy may own bubble finance, but this intake should not promote a forecast ledger from one livestream before comparison.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the boomers-built-a-hell passage as late evidence for gerontocratic self-entrapment: the old want to rule forever, create a hell for everyone, and then must live inside it too.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Gerontocracy owns age-class rule and self-entrapment. Free Will or Dante should receive the line only if a future pass foregrounds hell as chosen spiritual structure rather than generational regime.

chronology_notes.note: On 2026-06-13 Jiang moves from earlier classroom and channel-scale school dreams into an explicit life reorganization: he has left the school, plans to transition out of China, and treats the next year of travel as a search for a stable base where family, community, and school-building can coincide.

The source places a constructive and destructive school anthropology side by side: Kabbalah and proper technique can democratize creativity, while institutional schooling can blind people to telos and unravel the soul.

This livestream should be queued as a dated forecast packet, not promoted directly: it mixes immediate Iran-war claims, AI/financial-collapse claims, U.S. administration claims, relocation plans, and future livestream/course operations under the single date 2026-06-13.

next_actions.action: Next public synthesis should prefer a Living School chronology/replacement pass that routes this source as the practical exit-and-school-building turn; do not create standalone Exit From China, Paid Subscriber School, Future School, Malaysia School, or Jiang Relocation pages.
If Education is revised, use the source to sharpen the soul-game fork rather than append a broad occult section: democratized creativity and soul-unraveling are the reusable mechanism.

Queue the war, AI, financial-collapse, Trump, Tulsi, RFK, and Iran-peace claims for a later Prediction comparison pass; avoid canon-candidate promotion until adjacent dated sources and later outcomes are checked.
